results.title: Completely reset a single service in Docker Compose, including deleting the volumes? - Stack Overflow
results.snippet: I always use docker compose down -v <service>. It will stop it (if running), delete the container (if exists) and delete attached volumes. docker compose up -d <service> brings it back up from scratch.
